text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Setiawangsa-Pantai) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 November 2023.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Setiawangsa-Pantai

bermula—

(a) dari laluan utama di kilometer 14.598 di koordinat U 351024.165,

T 415417.341 Grid Bentuk Benar Serong Ditepati (RSO) Geosentrik

Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 15.293

di koordinat U 351673.509, T 415608.137 Grid RSO GDM2000,

iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 0.689 kilometer; dan

(b) dari Persimpangan Ampang Ramp 4B di kilometer 0.438

di koordinat U 350253.983, T 415460.724 Grid RSO GDM2000

dan berakhir di kilometer 0.618 di koordinat U 350229.271,

T 415608.653 Grid RSO GDM2000, iaitu suatu jarak

sepanjang 0.180 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

PETA LEBUH RAYA SETIAWANGSA-PANTAI

Dibuat 2 November 2023

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/44; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 129]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SETIAWANGSA-PANTAI EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Setiawangsa-Pantai

Expressway) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 November 2023.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Setiawangsa-Pantai Expressway

commencing—

(a) from the main line at kilometre 14.598 at coordinates

N 351024.165, E 415417.341 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic

(RSO) Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid and ending

at kilometre 15.293 at coordinates N 351673.509, E 415608.137

of the RSO GDM2000 Grid, being a distance of 0.689 kilometre; and

(b) from Ampang Interchange Ramp 4B at kilometre 0.438

at coordinates N 350253.983, E 415460.724 of the RSO GDM2000

Grid and ending at kilometre 0.618 at coordinates N 350229.271,

E 415608.653 of the RSO GDM2000 Grid, being a distance

of 0.180 kilometre,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Schedule.
